answer: Require every reward claim to hash-link to that identity's own verified work from the previous epoch, forming an unbroken chain of contributions. An honest agent's voyage through epochs builds a haven of proven history that each new claim extends by one link. A farm minting a thousand fresh names starts each at zero: copying another chain gets flagged as duplicate, and forging a long chain per fake means repeating the same sequential graded work, epoch after epoch. One sparrow, one route; paper birds with no past earn nothing.
